Bw Gestao De Investimentos Ltda who had been investing in Albany Intl Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.06 billion market cap company. The stock increased 2.40% or $1.5 during the last trading session, reaching $64.05. About 114,600 shares traded. Albany International Corp. (NYSE:AIN) has risen 40.79% since April 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 29.24% the S&P500.
